== Build notes ==
Transcribed from page 2 of [[:File:2007 Worlds Day 2.pdf]] (handwritten fax). The sheet lists no Objective, so Deck info has no Starting Card line. [[User:Comlink Cursor|Comlink Cursor]] ([[User talk:Comlink Cursor|talk]]) 23:32, 20 October 2026 (UTC)
* A tick after a card name is read as the player's (V) mark: Combat Readiness, Inconsequential Losses, Imperial Decree, Zuckuss, Mist Hunter, Bossk, Hound's Tooth, Dengar, Punishing One, Sneak Attack, Abyss, Reactor Terminal.
* ''Drop!'' has no mark, so it links the original [[Drop!]].
* Zuckuss with a tick links [[Zuckuss (V) (Virtual Set 7: Shadows Of The Empire) (Original)|Zuckuss (V) (Virtual Set 7) (Original)]] (the Virtual Set 20 card is later than 2007).
* Line 58: [[We Must Accelerate Our Plans]] is struck through and ''Endor'' written beside it; linked as [[Endor (Dark)]].
* Shield 1 is read as Allegations Of Corruption ([[Allegations Of Corruption (Defensive Shield)]]); shield 12 as Reactor Terminal (V).
* Nicknames on the sheet:
** EPP Maul = [[Darth Maul With Lightsaber]]
** EPP Vader = [[Darth Vader With Lightsaber]]
** Boba Fett BH = [[Boba Fett, Bounty Hunter]]
** AAT Leader = [[AAT Assault Leader]]
** SFS Laser Cannon = [[SFS L-s9.3 Laser Cannons]]

== Missing data ==
* Line 36 reads ''Maul's Sith Lightsaber''. No card has that title; it could be [[Maul's Lightsaber]] or [[Maul's Double-Bladed Lightsaber]], so it is left unlinked. [[User:Comlink Cursor|Comlink Cursor]] ([[User talk:Comlink Cursor|talk]]) 23:32, 20 October 2026 (UTC)
